# Rodentia
Rodentia are a race of humanoid beings resembling rodents. Resourceful, evasive, sneaky, but fragile.
## Unique Abilities
### Rummaging
- Rodentia can rummage in disposal chutes, which can sometimes [color=#1e90ff]dig up food.[/color] Yum!
### Rodent Storage
- Rodentia can store small items in their cheeks. Having items in their mouth makes their speech unintelligible and stops them eating or drinking, and they will spit out everything in their mouth if they are hit hard, knocked down, or shoved.
### Sneaking
- Due to their small stature and rodent instincts, Rodentia can [color=#1e90ff]sneak underneath tables.[/color] They move more slowly while sneaking, can't climb, and any shots they fire will hit the table above them. They are unable to sneak under doors.
### Mousecall
- Rodentia can [color=#1e90ff]call nearby mice[/color] to come to them.
## Diet
- Can eat raw meat. - Will get [color=#FFA500]poisoned[/color] by Theobromine (Chocolate, Tea, Coffee) and Allicin (Onion, Garlic).
## Benefits
- They can use their claws to do some [color=#ec3a3a]Slashing[/color] and [color=#ec3a3a]Blunt[/color] damage. - They weigh less than most species.
## Drawbacks
- Takes [color=#FFA500]15% more Blunt, Slash, and Piercing damage.[/color] - Always triggers mousetraps, regardless of whether or not they are wearing shoes. - Gets [color=#FFA500]hungry 33% faster.[/color]
## Voice
Rodentia squeak and chatter, can [color=#1e90ff]*squeak*[/color], and have a habit of turning their words into cheese puns.
